mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PERMISSION_ROLE_MAPPING ( PERM_ID, ROLE_ID ) SELECT P.PERM_ID, R.ROLE_ID FROM TB_PERMISSION P JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_CD = 'ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN' WHERE P.PERM_ENABLED = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PERMISSION_ROLE_MAPPING M WHERE M.PERM_ID = P.PERM_ID AND M.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID )
